data.name: Hijab
data.gender_notes: Hijab is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hijab is an Arabic word that means 'cover' or 'veil'. It is often used to refer to the headscarf worn by some Muslim women as a part of their modest dress. The name Hijab carries the meaning “Cover, veil” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hijab usually hope their child will grow to embody cover, veil and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the hijab is seen as a symbol of modesty and dignity. It is a reminder for both the wearer and those around them to focus on inner beauty and character rather than physical appearance.
data.etymology: Hijab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cover, veil.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hijab total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: حجاب
in_arabic.meaning: ستر پوشیدہ، پردہ، ستر کا لبادہ، چادر
in_arabic.long_meaning: حجاب اصل معنوں میں ستر پوشیدہ یا پردہ ہے۔ یہ نام حجاب کے اسلامی تصور سے ماخوذ ہے، جو اسلامی عقیدے کے مطابق عورتوں کے لیے ستر کا ایک ضروری حصہ ہے۔ قرآن میں حجاب کا ذکر سورہ نور میں کیا گیا ہے، جہاں یہ ستر کے حصول کے لیے ضروری ہدایات فراہم کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام روحانی پاکیزگی، عفت، اور اسلامی اقدار کی پابندی کی علامت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: حجاب
in_urdu.meaning: پردہ، ستر کا لبادہ، چادر، ستر پوشیدہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حجاب نام حجاب کے اسلامی تصور سے ماخوذ ہے، جو عورتوں کے ستر کے لیے ضروری ہے۔ یہ نام عفت، روحانی پاکیزگی، اور اسلامی اقدار کی پابندی کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشروں میں، حجاب نام روایتی اور اسلامی ثقافت کی عکاسی کرتا ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے اخذ کردہ، حجاب کا مطلب ہے ستر یا پردہ، جو اسلامی تعلیمات میں اہم ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हिजाब
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिजाब नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में पर्दा या वस्त्र को संदर्भित करता है। यह नाम इस्लामी शिक्षाओं से लिया गया है, जहां हिजाब महिलाओं के लिए आवश्यक माना जाता है। हिजाब नाम आध्यात्मिक शुद्धता, शील, और इस्लामी मूल्यों के पालन का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, हिजाब नाम पारंपरिक और इस्लामी संस्कृति को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: حجاب
in_pashto.meaning: په ډاګه کولو، ستر پټولو، چادر
in_pashto.long_meaning: حجاب نوم د حجاب د اسلامي مفهوم څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د ښځو د ستر لپاره ضروری دی. دا نوم د عفت، روحاني پاکۍ، او اسلامي ارزښتونو د پابندۍ نښه ده. د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو معاشرو کې، حجاب نوم د اسلامي او کلتوري دودونو منعکس کوونکی دی.

in_english.name: Hijab
in_english.meaning: a veil or headscarf worn by Muslim women
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hijab originates from the Arabic root 'ḥ-j-b', which means 'to veil' or 'to cover'. In Islamic tradition, Hijab refers to the act of covering or veiling, particularly for women. The term is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah An-Nur, which provides guidance on modesty and covering oneself. The name Hijab symbolizes modesty, chastity, and adherence to Islamic values. Across Muslim cultures, Hijab is a significant aspect of identity and faith.

data.cultural_impact: The hijab is an integral part of the Islamic dress code for women, signifying modesty and reducing the chances of eliciting unwanted attention. It is a visible symbol of Muslim identity and faith in many parts of the world. Has become a subject of intense debate, especially in the western world, as some see it as a sign of oppression while others view it as a symbol of empowerment.
data.spiritual_significance: The hijab is also viewed as a means of protecting one's spiritual and emotional sanctity. It is a reminder for the wearer to uphold high moral and ethical standards, and to keep her focus on her spiritual goals. It is a way of preserving her dignity and privacy, and of showing respect for her own self and for others. Ultimately, it is a physical manifestation of the deep inner commitment of a Muslim woman to her faith.
